generalSafeguards: A current OSM place tag and municipal containment establish mapped source candidates, not an official quarter classification.
A small settlement or lack of residents does not invalidate a historically named settlement part.
Industrial/forest/commercial words do not independently invalidate a municipality-defined quarter.
All remaining input features keep their existing unreviewed state; name screening does not certify them.
No recommendation deletes original geometry; semantic categories and reported fine-quarter totals should remain separate.
Web sources support municipal terms and names only; no exact municipal polygon matching is asserted.
